svg.title: The cities of the Mesopotamian gods
svg.desc: Most locations are cult seats. Explicit birth, conception and inferred shrine birth are distinguished. Complete evidence is in the companion catalogue.
svg.text: Cult centres and patron deities across ancient traditions.
The few located birth and conception traditions are marked separately.

g.text: Utu: shrine birth inferred; Aya: cult.

svg.text: Full passages, competing traditions and bibliography: khayoon.github.io/mesopotamian-gods-atlas
Modern-reference geography: GSHHG full-resolution coast · HydroRIVERS · Pleiades site points. Ancient channels varied.
